metadata.description: Manual seed graph facts for the Animal Farm RAG/KAG prototype.

facts.description: Napoleon uses the dogs as a private force to intimidate the animals and enforce his power.
The dogs chase Snowball off the farm, removing Napoleon's main rival.
The dogs help silence opposition and end open debate among the animals.
Squealer manipulates the animals through persuasive explanations that defend Napoleon's decisions.

facts.target_entity: Snowball's role in the Battle of the Cowshed
facts.description: Squealer rewrites Snowball's role in the Battle of the Cowshed to make Snowball seem like a traitor.
Squealer is connected to explanations and changes involving the commandments.
The commandments change over time from strict rules into altered wording that creates loopholes for the pigs.
Boxer is taken away in a van connected to the knacker, despite the animals being told a different story.
Snowball is blamed for problems on the farm, making him a convenient enemy for Napoleon's regime.
Napoleon becomes increasingly separated from the other animals and is guarded by dogs.
